themes_detail.label: Unsanitary Conditions Spike
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary condition complaints surged to 18 THIS WEEK, a 235% increase from the 5.4 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks, signaling a sudden deterioration in neighborhood cleanliness that warrants immediate investigation into root causes.
evidence: 18 unsanitary condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 5.4 weekly average (8-week baseline)
235% increase with z-score of 12.72 (extreme statistical anomaly)
Aligns with repeated CB budget requests for DSNY expense support, suggesting chronic sanitation capacity issues
reporting_angles: Investigate what triggered the spike: route changes, staffing shortages, or collection failures in specific neighborhoods
Interview residents on affected blocks about visible sanitation problems; map complaint locations
Contact DSNY for explanation and response plan; cross-check against missed collection complaints (253 over 90 days)

themes_detail.label: Elevator Outages Surge
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints exploded to 5 THIS WEEK from a baseline of 0.5 weekly average (900% increase), a sharp anomaly that likely affects elderly and disabled residents in multi-story buildings across the district.
evidence: 5 elevator complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average (8-week baseline)
900% spike with z-score of 9.0 (extreme statistical significance)
554 DOB building permits filed in 90 days (348 alterations) suggest ongoing construction that may be triggering elevator maintenance issues
reporting_angles: Identify which buildings are affected; interview elderly and disabled residents about access impacts
Contact DOB and building owners to determine if elevator failures are tied to construction, aging infrastructure, or inspection delays
Investigate elevator inspection backlog or contractor availability in the district

themes_detail.label: Facility Maintenance Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Maintenance or facility complaints jumped to 12 THIS WEEK, a 433% spike from the 2.2 weekly average, indicating widespread deterioration in public facility upkeep across parks, schools, or municipal buildings.
evidence: 12 maintenance/facility complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.2 weekly average (8-week baseline)
433% increase with z-score of 8.13 (high statistical anomaly)
Repeated CB budget requests for DPR park maintenance and DOE school facility spending suggest systemic underfunding
reporting_angles: Determine which facilities are cited most: parks, playgrounds, schools, or community centers; visit affected locations
Interview DPR and DOE to assess maintenance staffing levels and budget constraints
Cross-reference with CB's recurring requests for park and school facility funding to contextualize chronic underinvestment

themes_detail.label: Bus Stop Infrastructure Failures
themes_detail.summary: Bus stop shelter placement complaints jumped to 3 LAST WEEK, a 2300% increase from the 0.1 weekly average, suggesting rapid deterioration or removal of transit amenities that impacts daily commuters.
evidence: 3 bus stop shelter placement complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average (8-week baseline)
2300% spike with z-score of 8.69 (extreme statistical anomaly)
Aligns with CB's recurring DOT expense and capital requests, indicating persistent transit infrastructure issues
reporting_angles: Identify which bus stops lost or gained shelters; interview regular transit users about impact
Contact DOT/MTA to determine if shelters were removed, damaged, or relocated due to capital projects
Investigate why this amenity suddenly became a complaint focus after prolonged baseline silence

themes_detail.label: Street Sign Outages
themes_detail.summary: Missing street sign complaints surged to 6 TWO WEEKS AGO, a 586% increase from the 0.9 weekly average, affecting navigation and potentially creating safety hazards for drivers and pedestrians across the district.
evidence: 6 missing street sign complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 0.9 weekly average (8-week baseline)
586% increase with z-score of 5.53 (high statistical significance)
Recurring CB requests for DOT funding suggest chronic maintenance capacity gaps
reporting_angles: Map which intersections are missing signs; check DOT repair schedules
Interview residents and drivers about navigation impacts and safety concerns
Assess whether this is weather damage, vandalism, or delayed maintenance by DOT
